verdict.rationale: incident.io's postmortem AI docs say it can "generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI," which covers an AI first draft ready for human review. Related docs show an auto-generated timeline built from key events and AI suggestions that draft follow-up actions from incident activity. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the postmortem draft includes the timeline, contributing factors and follow-ups; no detail on draft structure; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
